_source:
Curriculum Development Centre Teaching Module — "Fashion and Fabrics Teaching Module Form 1 - Term 2" (https://library.cdcrepository.info/resource.php?id=310). Topic/sub-topic structure and competencies extracted with AI assistance (Gemini) directly from this module's own stated content — never invented; the extraction was instructed to use only what the module itself says, and to flag anything unclear rather than guess. Covers only the term this specific module addresses (Term 2) — other terms are not included since no source document for them was available at extraction time. AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: 1. Section 1.6 contains minor numbering irregularities in the source text where 'Sub-topic: Yarns' is marked with heading '1.6.1 Sub-topic: Yarns' immediately following '1.6.1 Sub-topic: Fibres', and Specific Competence '1.6.2.1' is listed under it.
2. In Topic 1.7, section 1.7.1 lacks an explicit 'Sub-topic: [Name]' header, jumping directly to 'Specific Competence 1.7.1.1: Create suitable textile design' and 'Activity 1: Explaining the key elements of design'; it was extracted under the descriptive title '1.7.1 Elements of Design' based on the section activity content.
3. Competencies were extracted from both the overarching 'General Competence(s)' blocks and the 'Specific Competence' headings explicit to each section.

subject.name: Fashion and Fabrics
subject.description: Fashion and Fabrics syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: TOPIC 1.5: TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT
topics.description: This topic covers various needlework tools and equipment essential for garment construction and household furnishings. It focuses on the usage, selection, care, maintenance, and functions of tools and equipment, including operating the sewing machine.

sub_topics.name: 1.5.1 Sub-topic: Needlework tools
sub_topics.description: Focuses on the use, choice, care, classification, and storage of hand sewing tools such as needles, tape measures, scissors, thimbles, and marking items to achieve precision and safety.

competencies.description: Analytical thinking: Describing the function of needlework tools and equipment
Emotional intelligence: Creating a tool kit with labelled pictures of various needlework tools and equipment
Problem solving: Using needlework tools correctly
Specific Competence: Use of needlework tools

sub_topics.name: 1.5.2 Sub-topic: Needlework Equipment
sub_topics.description: Explores major needlework equipment such as pressing irons, tailor's dummies, full-length mirrors, and chest of drawers, detailing their specific functions and care routines like dusting, covering, and oiling.

competencies.description: Critical thinking: Exploring different needlework equipment
Specific Competence: Use needlework equipment

sub_topics.name: 1.5.3 Sub-topic: The Sewing Machines
sub_topics.description: Covers the types, parts, selection, care, operation, and safety guidelines for sewing machines, guiding learners through setup, bobbin insertion, straight stitching, and basic maintenance.

competencies.description: Problem solving: Operating the sewing machine
Specific competence: Use a sewing machine

topics.name: 1.6 TOPIC: FIBRES AND FABRICS
topics.description: Explores the sources, types, properties, and uses of different natural and synthetic fibres and fabrics, emphasizing their transformation processes and sustainability in everyday life and industry.

sub_topics.name: 1.6.1 Sub-topic: Fibres
sub_topics.description: Examines raw textile units, classifying them into natural and synthetic origins, examining their physical properties, uses, and identification techniques such as burning, microscopic examination, and solubility tests.

competencies.description: Analytical thinking: Differentiate between natural and man-made fibres
Environmental Sustainability: Understand the importance of sustainable practices in fibre and fabric production
Digital Literacy: Use digital tools to research and explore the sources, types, properties, and uses of different fibres and fabrics
Creativity and Innovation: Apply knowledge of fibre properties to select suitable fabrics for specific purposes

sub_topics.name: 1.6.2 Sub-topic: Yarns
sub_topics.description: Focuses on the conversion of raw fibres into continuous strands of yarn through carding, spinning, and plying, analyzing yarn structures (single, ply, fancy) and basic knitting techniques.

competencies.description: Communication: Explain the processes involved in converting fibres into fabrics
Specific Competence: Practice the process of transforming fibres to yarns

sub_topics.name: 1.6.3 Sub-topic: Fabrics
sub_topics.description: Details the methods of converting yarns into fabrics, covering properties like strength, absorbency, and durability, as well as fabric construction via plain, twill, and satin weaves, and weft and warp knits.

competencies.description: Analytical thinking: Identify various types of fabrics and their characteristics
Specific Competence: Practice the process of transforming yarns to fabrics

sub_topics.name: 1.6.4 Sub-topic: Colour Application
sub_topics.description: Explores how colour affects mood, fabric characteristics, and aesthetics, while introducing traditional and modern colouring methods such as dyeing, printing, and painting using natural and synthetic colourants.

competencies.description: Specific Competence: Create desired artworks on Fabrics

sub_topics.name: 1.6.5 Sub-topic: Methods of Colour Application
sub_topics.description: Focuses on colour theory, the colour wheel, color schemes (primary, secondary, complementary, analogous), practical cotton fabric dyeing, and testing for colour fastness.

competencies.description: Specific Competence: Apply colour on fabrics

topics.name: TOPIC 1.7: CLOTHING DESIGN
topics.description: Combines art, culture, and technical principles to conceptualize, sketch, and develop functional, aesthetically pleasing garments suited to personal style, identity, and specific body shapes.

sub_topics.name: 1.7.1 Elements of Design
sub_topics.description: Introduces the basic visual building blocks of garment creation—line, shape, form, colour, texture, space, and value—and how they shape style, mood, and silhouette.

competencies.description: Creative Thinking and Innovation: Ability to generate original design ideas and apply creativity in clothing construction and decoration
Problem-Solving Skills: Identify and solve design and construction challenges using appropriate tools and techniques
Communication: Express design ideas clearly through sketches, oral presentations, and written descriptions
Collaboration and Teamwork: Work effectively in groups during practical work or design projects
Entrepreneurial Awareness: Develop an understanding of how clothing design can lead to income-generating opportunities
Environmental and Social Responsibility: Recognize sustainable practices in fabric selection and clothing production
Specific Competence 1.7.1.1: Create suitable textile design

sub_topics.name: 1.7.2 Sub-topic: Principle of Design
sub_topics.description: Covers design rules—including balance (symmetrical, asymmetrical, radial), harmony, emphasis, rhythm, proportion, and unity—and their application to fashion and interior design items.

competencies.description: Specific competence 1.7.2.1: Apply different principles of design

sub_topics.name: 1.7.3 Sub-topic: Figure Types
sub_topics.description: Examines distinct human body silhouettes (hourglass, pear, apple, rectangle, inverted triangle), teaching learners how to select and design flattering garment styles while avoiding common fashion mistakes.

competencies.description: Specific Competence 1.7.3.1: Select personal outfits according to figure types

topics.name: TOPIC 1.8: CONSTRUCTION PROCESSES
topics.description: Outlines the practical steps required to turn textile components into finished garments through pattern drafting, stitching, pressing, fitting, and neatening techniques.

sub_topics.name: 1.8.1 Sub-topic: Stitches
sub_topics.description: Covers hand stitching techniques categorized into temporary (basting), permanent (joining, neatening), and decorative stitches for functional garment assembly and aesthetic finishing.

competencies.description: Analytical Thinking: Identify different types of textiles and their sources
Critical Thinking: Understanding fabric properties and how they interact with patterns and sewing techniques
Emotional Intelligence: Practical Work - Hand Stitching Tasks
Problem Solving: Recognize the importance of sustainable practices during sewing
Financial Literacy: Explore Career Opportunities in sewing Industry
Specific Competence: Work out different hand stitches

sub_topics.name: 1.8.2 Sub-topic: Pressing and Ironing
sub_topics.description: Teaches the distinction between pressing and ironing, detailing equipment use, temperature settings, and techniques for pressing seams, darts, and pleats to achieve clean garment lines.

competencies.description: Specific Competence: Press and Iron articles during construction
